meta.name: add-dial
meta.description: Add Dial channel integration — a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

copy.tagline: 给应用接入真实号码,支持短信与AI语音通话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发需要电话或短信能力的应用
copy.tagline_en: Add a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs phone or SMS capabilities

howto.what: 让 Claude 获得一个真实电话号码，可收发短信和进行 AI 语音通话。技能会自动从 channels 分支复制 Dial 适配器、注册相关组件并安装依赖，再通过 dial 命令行工具与 Dial 平台双向通信。
howto.when: 当你要求为 Claude 接入 Dial 平台、添加可收发短信或拨打 AI 语音电话的真实号码，或想设置电话频道时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Dial 电话频道接进来
say.note: 开始应用技能、复制适配器并走配置流程。

say.text: 给我添加一个能收发短信和打电话的真实号码
say.note: 触发号码申请、登录验证与配对流程。

say.text: 我要用 Dial 号码接电话和收短信
say.note: 引导你完成权限选择、重启服务并绑定手机。

howto.what_en: Gives Claude a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls. The skill copies the Dial adapter from the channels branch, registers it, installs dependencies, and communicates with the Dial platform bidirectionally via the dial CLI.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to connect the Dial platform, add a real number for SMS/voice calls, or set up a phone channel for Claude.

say_en.text: Set up the Dial phone channel for me
say_en.note: Starts applying the skill and walking through configuration.

say_en.text: Give me a real number for texting and calls
say_en.note: Kicks off number provisioning, login, and pairing.

say_en.text: I want to receive calls and texts on a Dial number
say_en.note: Guides you through access choice, restart, and phone pairing.
